claims.summary: For a size-S>=2 depth-d binary DAG sequent refutation on its original variables, with no unused nodes or repeated multiset cedents, of a flat OR-of-literals CNF (units allowed) with at least one variable, no empty clauses and no tautological clauses, and every t>=1, a no-new-variable refutation with the same graph normal form has size O((S+t+1)^4), depth<=max(d,4), and exact zero-respecting prefix certificate C with C-A_t in the t-th power of every Boolean old-point two-sided ideal. Original generator labels are retained. This is not preservation of minimum proof size, constant-folded formula normal form or exact depth.
